name: Benaiah
bio: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was placed over David's bodyguard, the Cherethites and Pelethites, as part of the royal administration David established once his kingdom was secure (2 Samuel 8:18), a position he still held after Sheba's revolt was crushed (2 Samuel 20:23). Benaiah's own exploits as one of David's mightiest warriors, and his decisive role in securing Solomon's throne, are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
